column1: # Every project in the Dot family, and where it is cloned from.
# THIS IS THE ONLY COPY OF THIS LIST. bootstrap.sh and bootstrap.ps1 both read
# it, and `bootstrap --check` fails if a repository on disk is missing from it
# or a line here names something that is not there. Two copies of one list is
# the bug the list was guarding against, and this family has shipped that bug
# three times already: setup.sh against tools/check.sh against
# tools/package_check.sh, and bootstrap's own manifest, which had drifted to 19
# of 33 projects and had silently lost two of the five games.
# The addons each project needs are NOT here on purpose. They are derived from
# the /addons/<name> lines in that project's own .gitignore, which is the one
# place that can be right: the repository that gains a dependency is the
# repository that has to ignore its link, so the list maintains itself.
# This repository is not listed. It is the thing doing the cloning.
# Columns: name <TAB> clone URL, or the word LOCAL for a project with no remote
# yet -- a LOCAL project cannot be cloned onto another machine at all.
# A project named game-* has a playable client: `bootstrap --play <name>`.
